result.title: Chebyshev Polynomial Zonotope Abstractions for Certified Reachability of Learning-Enabled Systems
result.summary: Nearly all current methods for computing reachable sets of nonlinear dynamics propagate them with truncated Taylor expansions plus rigorous remainders. The expansion is pointwise: once its argument is a whole set rather than a point, one polynomial must stay accurate across that set, and it reaches only as far as its disc of convergence. The limit binds hardest on the rational terms and sigmoid gates of modern controllers: smooth as these look on the real line, in the complex plane they blow up at points just off the real axis, closer as a gate sharpens, and those points cap the set width a Taylor expansion can cover, most tightly on the switching surface where the controller decides. We prove a dichotomy: no Taylor degree certifies sets wider than that cap, while a Chebyshev abstraction of equal degree, anchored to the whole set in the same polynomial-zonotope pipeline, has no cap and gains width at a geometric rate in degree. Measured walls match the formulas to between 89 and 94 percent. We give closed-form rigorous remainders, among them the first polynomial softmax transformer; existing sound treatments are linear relaxations. On closed loops, certificates survive where the Taylor ones diverge, and specifications flip from unknown to proven; on trained classifiers up to real MNIST digits, the Chebyshev frontier certifies input territory the Taylor basis surrenders. Every certified claim passed large Monte-Carlo harnesses with zero violations, and an applicability map states in advance where the basis provably cannot matter.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出以截断 Taylor 展开传播非线性系统可达集时，集合输入会使精度受收敛圆盘限制，提出在 polynomial-zonotope 流程中改用 Chebyshev 抽象并给出闭式严格余项界（含 polynomial softmax transformer），并在闭环控制与训练分类器上对比认证范围。
AI.relevance_reason: 其严格集合传播与 softmax transformer 余项界，可能为多步或循环 latent 推理状态的可证范围及停止决策提供认证工具，属远领域方法线索，迁移可行性需核查。
